limits_and_boundaries.local_check_only: Read-only inspection of git repository state; cannot prevent external out-of-session modifications
limits_and_boundaries.worktree_detection: Detects worktree via .git file type or git-dir != git-common-dir
limits_and_boundaries.hook_status: Checked only via core.hooksPath git config without relying on specific hook files
limits_and_boundaries.branch_patterns: Enforces worker task/TK-nnnn-Rn, lead lead/<slug> or upgrade/<version>, reviewer review/CYC-nn-Rk-xxxx or legacy patterns
limits_and_boundaries.push_targets: Rejects refs/heads/main, refs/tags/*, and destination refs differing from current working branch
